features: 4-in-1 Cross-Device Connectivity — 128GB of Versatile Storage – Connect to every device you own with four built-in connectors — USB-A, USB Type-C, Lightning, and Micro USB. Store 128GB of photos, videos, music, and documents accessible across all platforms without adapters.

USB 3.0 Speed — 100MB/s Read for Fast File Transfers – Transfer 128GB worth of data between devices significantly faster than USB 2.0 alternatives. USB 3.0 technology ensures smooth, lag-free transfers of large multimedia files and project archives.

i-FlashDevice HD — Direct Mobile Playback Without Transfer – Stream music and play videos directly from the drive to your smartphone or tablet. No file copying required — simply plug in and enjoy your media library instantly.

Universal iOS, Android, Windows & Mac Compatibility – Designed to work seamlessly across all major platforms and devices without complex configuration or third-party software. Plug-and-play simplicity for every user.
128GB Storage + 10-Year Warranty — Maximum OTG Value – EVM's 10-year manufacturer warranty ensures reliable, long-term performance for all your cross-device storage and transfer needs.
description: Introducing the EVM EnStore 4-in-1 OTG Flashdrive - a high-speed USB 3.0 solution with a 128GB capacity. It offers seamless file transfers between USB-A, Android, iOS, and Type-C devices, laptops, and desktops. With super-fast speeds, you can effortlessly transfer photos, movies, and music. Easily transfer data to/from your mobile device, laptop, or PC. Play videos and music directly from the i-FlashDevice HD. Compatible with All Smartphone including , Mac, and PC. Read speed of 100Mb/s and write speed of 25Mb/s ensure quick and secure file transfers. Comes with a 10-year warranty. Streamline your file transfers and enhance your data management with this versatile flashdrive.
